mobileMenu.quoteText: Tell us about your renovation project

quoteHighlight.title: Start your renovation project with clarity
quoteHighlight.description: Share a few details about your project and timeline. Our team will review your request and provide a clear next step so your renovation can move forward with confidence.

steps.third: Move forward with a clear plan

about.title: More Than Renovation
about.description: Your apartment, house, or business space is more than walls and square meters. It is your lifestyle, your comfort, your peace, and the atmosphere you return to every day. We help transform raw interiors into spaces that reflect who you are and how you want to live.

services.title: Complete Interior Finishing, One Trusted Team
services.description: From planning and cost estimation to finishing works and final details, we provide comprehensive renovation and fit-out services under one roof. Our work combines technical precision, practical coordination, and a strong focus on quality, so every stage moves forward with confidence.

projects.title: Spaces That Speak for Themselves
projects.description: Every completed project tells a story of transformation. From modern apartments to commercial interiors, our portfolio reflects careful workmanship, functional thinking, and a commitment to creating spaces that look right, feel right, and work beautifully in everyday life.

process.title: A Clear Process from First Contact to Final Result
process.description: Good renovation starts with good structure. Our process is designed to make every step understandable and well organized — from consultation and on-site assessment to scheduling, coordination, material support, and execution. Clear stages mean fewer surprises and better results.

contact.title: Let’s Talk About Your Space
contact.description: Whether you are planning a full turnkey fit-out, a renovation, or selected finishing works, we are here to guide you. Reach out to discuss your project, ask questions, and take the first step toward a space designed around your needs.

hero.title: About PRO100 Twój Remont
hero.subtitle: Reliable renovation and interior finishing built on trust, quality, and organized execution.

stats.title: Built on experience. Proven by results.
stats.description: We shape renovation and interior projects through a process that feels structured, elegant, and easy to follow from first conversation to final outcome.

story.title: Who We Are
story.content: We are a renovation and interior finishing company focused on delivering complete, high-quality spaces for people who want more than construction work — they want clarity, trust, and a result they can truly enjoy. We work on apartments, homes, and commercial interiors, helping clients turn empty or unfinished spaces into places with character, comfort, and purpose.

values.title: Our Values
values.content: We believe in reliability, clear communication, respect for the client’s space, accountable workmanship, and organized execution.

first.title: Reliability
first.text: We deliver what we promise, maintaining consistency and accountability at every stage of the project.

second.title: Precision
second.text: Every detail is approached with care, ensuring the final result feels refined, balanced, and complete.

third.title: Partnership
third.text: We work closely with our clients, creating a process that feels clear, collaborative, and supportive.

fourth.title: Professional Structure
fourth.text: We operate with clear systems and organized workflows to ensure every project runs smoothly and efficiently.

cta.title: See what it’s like to work with us
cta.description: Explore real feedback from clients who trusted us with their homes and interiors, and see how the process felt from their perspective.

trustedBrands.title: Our projects combine quality, functionality, and refined design.
trustedBrands.description: Experience, precision, and a responsible approach to every project are why clients who expect the highest standard choose us.

whyChooseUs.title: Design-led thinking, structured guidance, and a more considered way to renovate
whyChooseUs.description: The strongest projects rely on more than taste alone. They need clarity, trust, and a process that feels as thoughtful as the final result.

first.title: Tailored Approach
first.description: Every project begins with context, constraints, and goals, so each solution feels intentional, relevant, and carefully shaped.

second.title: Clear Communication
second.description: From first contact to final delivery, the process is structured to feel transparent, calm, and easy to navigate.

third.title: Architectural Precision
third.description: Careful detailing, visual discipline, and a considered process create outcomes that feel refined, balanced, and enduring.

why.title: Why People Choose Us
why.content: Clients choose us because they want a team that combines craftsmanship with trust. We help make the renovation process easier to understand, stay in contact throughout the work, support material decisions, and deliver spaces that feel complete — not just finished.

hero.title: Our Services
hero.subtitle: Comprehensive renovation and interior finishing for apartments, homes, and commercial spaces.

intro.title: What We Provide
intro.description: We provide renovation and interior finishing services for apartments, homes, and commercial properties. Our offer is designed for clients who want dependable execution, thoughtful coordination, and a final result that is both visually strong and practically complete.

section.title: Service Matrix
section.description: A clear overview of our renovation and finishing services, designed to feel refined, easy to understand, and simple to explore.

kitchen.title: Turnkey Interior Finishing
kitchen.description: Complete finishing solutions for new apartments, houses, and commercial spaces — from preparation and technical works to final details.

bathroom.title: Renovation and Reconstruction
bathroom.description: Interior renovation tailored to the condition of the space and the client’s goals, whether the project involves modernization, redesign, or full transformation.

basement.title: Painting and Wall Finishing
basement.description: Traditional and spray painting, plastering, smoothing, and surface preparation that create a clean, high-quality base and finish.

fullHome.title: Drywall and Ceiling Systems
fullHome.description: Partition walls, plasterboard structures, suspended ceilings, and custom interior build-outs shaped around the layout and function of the space.

commercial.title: Flooring, Tiling, and Finishing Details
commercial.description: Professional installation of flooring systems, tile works, interior doors, and other finishing elements that complete the space with precision and consistency.

carpentry.title: Electrical, Plumbing, and Material Support
carpentry.description: Core technical installations, renovation supervision, developer unit handover support, and assistance with organizing and purchasing materials.

kitchen.desc: A complete service for new or existing interiors, delivered through a clear process, technical care, and a polished final result.

first.body: We review the space, define the scope, and align the work with your needs and expectations.

second.title: Planning
second.body: We organise the order of works, materials, and technical requirements before execution begins.

third.title: Delivery
third.body: We complete the work with attention to finish quality, detail, and final visual consistency.

bathroom.desc: Bathroom and wet-area work delivered with care, technical precision, and a focus on durability and clean detailing.

first.body: We assess the space, installation needs, and finish conditions before defining the right scope.

second.title: Preparation
second.body: We organise technical works, substrate preparation, and materials in the correct sequence.

third.title: Finish
third.body: We deliver the completed bathroom with attention to waterproofing, alignment, and final detailing.

basement.desc: Clean wall preparation and finishing work that builds the visual base of the interior with consistency and care.

first.title: Surface check
first.body: We inspect wall condition, unevenness, and preparation requirements before finish work begins.

second.title: Refinement
second.body: We perform smoothing, patching, levelling, and preparation to create a strong finish base.

third.title: Completion
third.body: We complete the final finish with a clean, even result ready for everyday use.

fullHome.desc: Drywall, ceiling, and layout-defining structures designed to support both the function and composition of the interior.

first.title: Layout review
first.body: We examine the intended layout, proportions, and technical needs of the space.

second.title: Build-out
second.body: We construct framing, partitions, and ceiling systems with precision and proper sequencing.

third.title: Integration
third.body: We prepare the system for lighting, finishes, and the next stages of the interior works.

commercial.desc: Commercial finishing and fit-out work delivered with structure, coordination, and attention to the operational needs of the space.

first.title: Briefing
first.body: We define the business, layout, and finish requirements that shape the project scope.

second.title: Coordination
second.body: We organise technical works, site sequencing, and finish packages to support efficient delivery.

third.title: Turnover
third.body: We complete the space with attention to usability, finish quality, and overall consistency.

carpentry.desc: Core installation support and renovation coordination that help the full project move forward with greater clarity and control.

first.title: Review
first.body: We identify the installation and support requirements needed to prepare the project properly.

second.title: Organisation
second.body: We coordinate the materials, technical tasks, and site logic needed for smooth execution.

third.title: Delivery
third.body: We ensure the work is completed in a way that supports the wider project and final result.

hero.subtitle: A collection of completed spaces shaped by craftsmanship, structure, and care.

intro.title: Spaces That Reflect Our Standard
intro.description: Our projects reflect the range of spaces we help transform — from private apartments and homes to client-facing commercial interiors. Each one is a practical collaboration between vision, workmanship, and execution.

section.title: Selected projects that reflect our standard
section.description: A curated overview of spaces shaped through careful execution, functional thinking, and a clear visual direction.

modernKitchen.description: A contemporary residential project focused on balance, material clarity, and a calm everyday atmosphere.

downtownOffice.description: A commercial interior shaped around visual identity, practical planning, and a more confident client-facing experience.

masterBathroom.description: A bathroom transformation built around detail, proportion, and a cleaner, more refined finish language.

historicHome.description: A full-home renovation that brought structure, warmth, and modern comfort into an existing residential setting.

retailStore.description: A service-oriented commercial space designed to support both experience, clarity, and operational flow.

basementConversion.description: A custom interior transformation that turned underused square footage into a more valuable and coherent living zone.

preview.title: Selected work that reflects clarity, atmosphere, and careful execution
preview.description: Projects should show more than surface appeal. They should reflect proportion, intention, and the quality of decisions behind the finished result.

first.title: Family House

second.title: Commercial Space

hero.title: Our Process
hero.subtitle: A clear, organized path from first contact to finished space.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.description: You contact us by phone or message and tell us about your space, your needs, and your goals. This first conversation helps define the direction of the project.

design.title: Assessment & Estimate
design.description: We visit the site, assess the condition and scope of work, and prepare a cost estimate based on the real needs of the project.

proposal.title: Coordination & Agreement
proposal.description: We reserve the timeline, discuss the stages of work, confirm the details, and finalize cooperation through a clear agreement.

construction.title: Start of Works
construction.description: We organize materials, prepare the site, and begin the renovation step by step with structured execution and ongoing coordination.

walkthrough.title: Completion & Handover
walkthrough.description: We review the completed work with you, confirm the final details, and make sure the finished space meets the agreed standard.

quote.title: Request a Quote
quote.description: Tell us about your property, your goals, and the type of work you need. We will review your request, discuss the next steps, and help you move toward a well-planned renovation with clarity from the very beginning.
